answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops sybil farming: work counts only after 20 distinct counterparties. Each exchange is signed with the agent's quill; the breadth of that set is the diversity signal. A plume of partners proves real activity, while clones trading only with each other score zero. Forging 100 identities needs 2,000 relationships at 5 POA each, costing 10,000 POA; an honest agent pays nothing extra and keeps its full share.
